info.title: CodeMeridian.Indexer
info.description: Unified CodeMeridian indexer CLI for C#, TypeScript/TSX, and documentation.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: CodeMeridian Indexer - unified CLI for indexing codebases into CodeMeridian.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --project
options.description: Project context name. If omitted, auto-detected from config or the target root.

options.name: --url
options.description: CodeMeridian server URL.

options.name: --clear
options.description: Remove existing knowledge before indexing. Applied only once. [default: False]

options.name: --keywords
options.description: Rebuild the derived keyword graph after indexing completes. This is now the default. [default: False]

options.name: --skip-keywords
options.description: Skip rebuilding and classifying the derived keyword graph after indexing. [default: False]

options.name: --skip-docs
options.description: Skip documentation ingestion. [default: False]

options.name: --watch
options.description: Watch mode. If both languages are present, C# watch runs first. [default: False]

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Show what would be indexed without ingesting anything. [default: False]

options.name: --list-capabilities
options.description: Show available indexers on this machine. [default: False]

options.name: --skip-csharp
options.description: Skip C# indexing. [default: False]

options.name: --skip-typescript
options.description: Skip TypeScript/TSX indexing. [default: False]

options.name: --skip-config
options.description: Skip configuration indexing. [default: False]

options.name: --skip-diagnostics
options.description: Skip project-native compiler, TypeScript, and lint diagnostics indexing. [default: False]

options.name: --allow-repo-scripts
options.description: Allow repo-controlled build and lint commands during diagnostics. [default: False]

options.name: --no-incremental
options.description: Ignore .meridian/cache and scan all enabled files. [default: False]

options.name: --storage
options.description: Cache storage mode for this run: repo or global.
